en: A color image showing a young woman in elaborate, brightly colored traditional festival clothing, including a multicolored dress decorated with ribbons and floral patterns and an ornate headdress with wire and fabric ornaments. She stands in the foreground against a bamboo railing. In the background is a colonial-era town with whitewashed buildings and a prominent white church with a bell tower lining a narrow street filled with people, suggesting a procession or festival in a tropical, mountainous setting with large palm trees.
